messages:

Cc: contracts@somahealth.com

Subject: Pilot -> Annual conversion: surge needs & pricing

Hi Nikhil / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with latency and cost profile. We have a short runway for a pilot (Q4) but the business is planning to go annual if the pilot supports a short-term surge (20M tokens/day peak for 2 weeks) during a product launch.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood accommodate spike capacity without catastrophic overage?
- Pricing: to greenlight the pilot + convert to annual, Procurement is asking for an introductory pilot discount and a committed discount if we convert within 90 days. Rough ask is ~30% off list.

Attached is our SOW and expected usage profile.

Would like to move fast — can you provide an internal memo for approvals (cost impact, one-time surge credit, suggested annual discount tiers)? We can loop legal after sign-off.

Thanks,
Rahul Desai
Head of Platform
SomaHealth

Attachments: SomaHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot -> Annual conversion: surge needs & pricing

Ben — forwarding Rahul's ask. Quick summary and my recommended approach below for finance/VP review.

Summary:
- Pilot: Q4, expected baseline 2M tokens/day with a 2-week surge to ~20M/day.
- Ask: pilot discount (~30% requested) and an annual committed discount if conversion occurs within 90 days.

Recommended commercial structure (pre-approval ask to finance):
1) Pilot: 3-month paid pilot at 25% off list to lower friction to start; include automatic burst capacity with a capped one-time surge credit to cover expected overage risk (suggest $15,000).
2) Annual conversion: 12–24 month commitment with stepped discounts based on ARR: 12 months -> 15% off; 24 months -> 18% off.
3) Guardrails: soft cap on burst capacity (we keep ability to throttle beyond agreed burst) and a one-time engineering ramp plan to provision extra GPU pool during the launch window.

Attached: redwood-pricing-memo.xlsx (breakdown: cost to us at projected token profile, estimated margin impact, and suggested credit).

Can you review and advise if CFO sign-off required or if this can be approved by Finance lead? I'll hold off external reply until I have guidance.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Executive approval request: SomaHealth pilot concession (RDW-13847)

Marissa — looping you directly for sign-off. Below is the ask and commercial impact (TL;DR + numbers).

External ask (from SomaHealth): 30% pilot discount, plus committed conversion discount if they convert to annual within 90 days. They will also require guaranteed burst handling for a two-week launch spike (~20M tokens/day).

Our recommended structure (from Nikhil):
- Pilot (3 months): 25% off list; one-time surge credit = $15,000 to cover expected overage during 2-week peak.
- Annual conversion: 12mo -> 15% off; 24mo -> 18% off. Sales is proposing we accept 18% for 24-month commit to lock ARR.

Financial impact (high level):
- Estimated pilot revenue (at 25% off): $60k.
- One-time credit: $15k (applied as invoice credit).
- If they convert to 24mo at proposed rates, ACV ~ $420k (net of discount) — margin remains positive given expected batching/kv cache benefits.

Risks / Conditions:
- Require legal to vet SOW and include surging guardrails and a maximum total burst allowance.
- Require that the surge credit is one-time, non-renewing, and tied to measured tokens during the launch window.
- Engineering to confirm we can provision the burst without SLA degradation (eng to confirm schedule).

Attachments: redwood-pricing-memo.xlsx (cost model), SomaHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (customer SOW).

Can you approve this structure (VP/CFO sign-off) or suggest edits? If approved, I will send a short commercial memo to Rahul and push to Legal/Deal Desk.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive approval request: SomaHealth pilot concession (RDW-13847)

Thanks for the clear write-up. I reviewed the attached cost model and the ARR profile. Approve the following, on the conditions below: 

Approvals granted:
- One-time surge credit: $15,000 (applied as invoice credit for observed overage during the defined launch window).
- Pilot pricing: 25% off list for up to 3 months.
- Annual conversion: up to 18% off for a 24-month commitment; 15% for 12-month term.

Conditions / next steps:
1) Legal must include explicit burst window language and an objective token-metering clause. No open-ended surge commitments.
2) Engineering confirmation required that we can deliver the 20M/day peak without impacting other commitments; please get a scheduling note from infra and cc me.
3) Deal Desk should record the credit as non-recurring; any further commercial concessions require VP-level sign-off.
4) Update HubSpot deal RDW-13847 with approved discount tiers and add DocuSign link for pilot SOW.

Ben — please send the proposed memo to Rahul with the approved terms and the following DocuSign link to begin signature: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/rdw-13847. Keep legal and infra on the thread.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
